dslRule:
/*!id: template.validate-name-for-xml*/
<!description: Encapsulate template name retrieval with XML validation for safety.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: validation, xml, security>

$template.getName() :: instanceof($template, "org.eclipse.jface.text.templates.Template")
=>
org.eclipse.jface.text.templates.persistence.TemplateReaderWriter.validateXML($template.getName())
;;

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
